headline: Everest uses next to no processor while it waits in the menu bar.

items.title: Much lighter in the background
items.detail: With its window closed, Everest kept redrawing its pages out of sight and used about 15 % of a processor core all day. It now draws nothing until you open it: under 1 %.

items.title: Lighter with the window open
items.detail: The DisplayPad's live keys are drawn again only when what they show changes.
